relationships.subject: sulfur mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that ADAM17 was markedly upregulated in the corneal basement membrane 3 days post SM exposure

relationships.subject: sulfur mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: SM exposure was associated with a time related increase in tenascin-C expression throughout the stroma.

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: interfering with VEGF in the cornea using bevacizumab, a humanized monoclonal anti-VEGF antibody or aflibercept, a fusion protein with high affinity for VEGF, suppress SM-induced neovascularization

key_findings: Sulfur mustard vapor caused persistent corneal edema, neovascularization and epithelial-stromal separation in rabbits.
SM altered perlecan and fibronectin, and increased ADAM17 and tenascin-C.
